QuestInfo.name: Just For You 1
QuestInfo.0: Apparently there is another weird tradition in Fox Point Village to celebrate a kit's first successful hunt for food. Moonbeam said the townsfolk are preparing something for you.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam said the gift is 'just perfect' for you. You're more than a little suspicious, but go back to your house and check out the gift anyway.
QuestInfo.2: Oh boy, raw liver! It might be a delicacy for foxes, but you don't really see the appeal. Hopefully they'll let it slide.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1200\r\nCan proceed to Halfhearted Thanks (Lv. 18 or higher)

0.0: I'm glad you're not too dumb. I mean, I was thinking of leaving you again at the Fox Tree, but you're not half bad.
0.1: Anyway, you should head back to town. I heard everyone prepared something for you. Adults usually have a gift for baby foxes when they succeed at their first hunt. You should go see it for yourself. It was really hard to get.

yes.0: Er... I was only helping the adults because they were busy! I had no choice! Don't get me wrong, I never, ever stepped up to help first.

no.0: Do you know how much time and energy I spent on that gift? Go to your house! Now!

default.0: Did you forget where your house is? It's not as tasty if it cools... No, no. Just go already!
